Compares to Notion for workflow mapping, traditional project management tools, stand-alone organizational chart creators Get Puzzle on AppSumo Introduction to Puzzle: Your Business' Source of TruthIn most businesses, finding accurate and up-to-date documentation about how things actually get done can be frustrating. Procedures might live in multiple places - a few SOPs in one location, supporting spreadsheets in another, with crucial changes announced in Slack messages that never make it back into the official documentation. That leaves many companies dependent on that one employee who knows how stuff actually works, leaving the business vulnerable if they're unavailable or leave the company. Puzzle addresses this challenge by providing a platform for creating complete visual representations of business processes, team structures, software tools, and role assignments in one central source of truth.AI Connector FeaturePuzzle is fundamentally a workflow mapping platform that allows you to map out every action in your business. But it goes beyond basic workflow visualization by integrating team management features - allowing you to add your entire staff with department structure, roles within departments, and specific assignments for process responsibilities. The platform also lets you incorporate all the software tools you use for each team and each workflow, so you can see who has access to what, and how different software components contribute to specific business processes.Understanding the Core Value PropositionWhat initially attracted me to Puzzle was its potential synergies with AI tools through its MCP (Model Context Protocol) connector. This means AI assistants like Claude or specialized custom agents can access the complete business map I've constructed in Puzzle. This includes information about organizational structure - who performs which roles, how business functions interconnect, and software dependencies. This enables AI tools to both utilize organizational context in their decision-making and potentially help maintain the business documentation as operations evolve.Workspace StructureFor businesses of any size, one of the greatest challenges is the risk inherent in knowledge concentration on one or two individuals who understand how everything operates. Puzzle mitigates this by making organizational knowledge explicitly visual. This creates a structured foundation that can be accessed by both humans and AI tools. Even if you run a one-person company experimenting with AI automation, Puzzle can help formalize your business processes into a coherent map that any AI system can understand.Exploring the Puzzle InterfacePuzzle organizes everything around your Organization, which contains multiple workspaces. Each AppSumo plan level (including the lowest tier) provides unlimited workspaces, which is particularly useful if you run a service-based business with clients. You could create separate dedicated workspaces to visualize technology recommendations for specific clients, making complex technical suggestions more comprehensible compared to traditional written proposals.Workflows Tab ExplainedWithin each workspace, Puzzle maintains a consistent set of five main functional areas accessible via top tabs: Workflows, Teams, People, Tools, and Changelog. Unlike flexible platforms such as Notion where you have unlimited creative freedom, Puzzle provides predefined structure within each workspace. Every workspace follows the same framework, ensuring consistency in how your various business entities are documented.Workflows: Documenting What You DoThe Workflows tab represents the core of your operational processes.
